This collaboration aims to assist veterans in leveraging their expertise and backgrounds for successful avenues in high-quality employment post their military service.

data.description: With the start of the World Series approaching this Friday, a message from Stone puts out a call for league commissioners, owners, and players to come together during this weekend's games to bring together a nation that is currently divided over finding a cure for disease.
